## From a table to a graph {#l2-histogram-rules }

::: {.split }
::: {.column-block}

<h3>Histogram</h3>

- Numerical values on the horizontal axis.
- Adjoining rectangles.
- Discrete values at the centres of their bars.
- Frequency determines each height.

:::

::: {.column-block}

<h3>Frequency polygon</h3>

- Plot at each value or class centre.
- Join neighbouring points with straight segments.
- Return to zero one class before and one class after.

:::
:::
<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 41 · Complete the working in your booklet.</p>

::: notes
Equal-width classes are used throughout these lessons. No frequency-density interpretation for unequal-width classes is required here. Adjoining columns matter: a default spreadsheet column chart with gaps needs formatting.
:::
